summary: Preserved candidate 436f0c1f's GLM-5.3 processor registration and preprocessing, reproduced the independent review's repeated-image-token serving-path failure on that exact candidate, and fixed it by collapsing processor-expanded spans only for list-valued glm5_next inputs before load_mm_data. This fixes the concrete reviewed defect but does not establish the cause of the original deployment's semantic misidentification.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before on the exact candidate: load_mm_data received four consecutive image tokens for one supplied image rather than one collapsed placeholder.

Passing-after: 10 tests covered candidate registration/JPEG preprocessing/resize behavior, repeated-span normalization through process_mm_data_async, distinct spans, sequence boundaries, and unchanged glm4v behavior.
Nine committed regression and boundary tests passed.
All applicable formatting, lint, safety, and CI-registration checks passed after formatter changes.

gpu_execution_evidence: Inventory confirmed one AMD Instinct MI350X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2. No GLM-5.3 model inference ran because the private weights and exact image were unavailable.
remaining_limitations: The exact Statue of Liberty JPEG, private GLM-5.3-Flash-sglang0907-128k-0907t3 weights, 8x NVIDIA H20 topology, CUDA environment, and original deployment were unavailable. Landmark semantics and the cause of the already-processed bird response remain unverified. No native source changed, so a native rebuild was not applicable.
